label: README.md:191's first-session hook-install claim has a working, trust-independent mechanism: check-git-hooks.sh selects its source root by sentinel only (no trust check) and, with live-sync enabled and this checkout being the main checkout, self-heals by running the installer and printing 'auto-installed git hook symlinks (self-heal)'. It is wired into the .claude/.codex/.cursor/.devin/.opencode/.hermes SessionStart chains; .pi references the guard from its extensions docs. skilled.trustRepoHooks gates the check scripts in secondary checkouts, not this self-heal, which resolves the README:191 vs iteration-3 trust tension.

Codex/Cursor/Devin SessionStart adapters resolve untracked .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/dist/hooks/<host>/session-start.js; runtime/dist carries 0 tracked files and the documented install never builds it (root postinstall only records the node version; the runtime workspace build is only run when invoked), so sessions before a spec-kit workspace build emit one mk-hook-drift stderr notice plus a rebuild-remedy context per adapter. Loud but recoverable; candidate F7 (P3): one clause in step 3 prose naming that the build feeds the session-start hooks.

All seven runtime surfaces ship tracked first-session machinery (real tracked trees: .opencode 58, .pi 169, .claude 80, .codex 71, .cursor 78, .devin 44, .hermes 111 tracked files); .claude/SYNC.md documents the model (whole-dir symlinks, generated per-file command mirrors, hand-authored settings.json, guarded .claude/agents fork). The First Use documentation gap for the six non-OpenCode runtimes is carried from iteration 1 (registry entry, not re-read this iteration).

Tracked .claude/settings.json ships permissions.defaultMode=bypassPermissions, skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt=true and env.SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=0; tracked .pi/settings.json ships defaultProjectTrust=always. None of the checked doc surfaces (README, .claude/SYNC.md, .skilled/repo-rules, system-spec-kit SKILL.md) mention these values; settings.json is hand-authored by design. If honored by the runtimes, external users silently run with permission prompts bypassed and the spec gate disabled; merge precedence was not probed, so this records the shipped default only.

Fix-set anchors re-verified unchanged: README.md:160 (Node floors, no Node 24), :162 (false auto-build claim), :164-177 (numbered steps omit hook trust), :197 (trust sentence), :191 (first-session hook install has its prose home, so F4 is a discoverability fix, not a missing-mechanism fix). No fix text has drifted since iteration 3's fix set.
